dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive, symmetric narrowing from the mid-back toward the posterior peduncle, exhibiting a smooth geometric transition.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth with a slight, localized convex bulge on the right margin relative to the left.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Consistent slate grey baseline tone indicative of a sub-adult; high-intensity specular highlights present along the dorsal midline.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency mottling; diffuse lighter-grey patches are visible along the lateral flanks and posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between primary pigmented areas and lighter textural variations, with no sharp edges visible.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined, light-colored linear dorsal ridge extending along the posterior half of the visible body axis.
